encoding.crossings: every bridge and tunnel once: both heads, length in middle tiles, transport, the direction from the first head (0 NE, 1 SE, 2 SW, 3 NW) and the owner
encoding.foundations: one string per row, one hex digit per tile: the foundation the tile's content stands on (0 none, 1 leveled, 2 inclined along x, 3 inclined along y, 4 steep lower, 5 steep both, 6-9 half tile W/S/E/N, a-d rail anti-zig-zag W/S/E/N)
encoding.occupancy: every tile with a train, road vehicle or ship on it now, with the vehicles' ids (the front part) and types
encoding.rails: one string per row, two hex digits per tile: the TrackBits (X=1, Y=2, upper=4, lower=8, left=16, right=32) of plain rail, rail stations, depots, crossings and rail bridge or tunnel heads
encoding.roads: one string per row (y), one hex digit per tile (x): the directions a road vehicle can leave the tile, a sum of NW=1 (y-1), SW=2 (x+1), SE=4 (y+1), NE=8 (x-1). Covers road pieces, drive-through and bay stops, depots (their entrance), level crossings and road bridge or tunnel heads. Two tiles are joined when each points at the other.
